definition: Words changed from one language into another.
examples: I read the English translation of the book.
This translation isn't very good.
She does translation for a law firm.

spanish.definition: Palabras cambiadas de un idioma a otro.

definition: A bus or plane that goes back and forth between two places; a spacecraft.
examples: The hotel has a free airport shuttle.
We took the shuttle to the parking lot.
The space shuttle went into orbit.

spanish.definition: Bus o avión que va y viene entre dos lugares; nave espacial.

definition: Happening at the beginning; the first letter of a name.
examples: My initial reaction was surprise.
Her initials are M.J.
The initial cost was very high.

spanish.definition: Que pasa al principio; primera letra de un nombre.

definition: A room where scientists work.
examples: She works in a laboratory.
They tested the water in a laboratory.
The school has a new science laboratory.

spanish.definition: Cuarto donde trabajan los científicos.

definition: A sea animal with a hard shell and ten legs.
examples: We ate crab at the beach.
A little crab walked across the sand.
Maryland is famous for its crab cakes.

spanish.definition: Animal de mar con caparazón duro y diez patas.

definition: Very unfriendly.
examples: The crowd was hostile.
Why are you so hostile toward me?
He gave me a hostile look.

spanish.definition: Muy poco amistoso.

definition: Connected to the art and the ideas of a society.
examples: There are many cultural differences between our countries.
The city has a rich cultural life.
We went to a cultural event.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el arte y las ideas de una sociedad.

definition: To make something more modern; new information.
examples: I need to update my phone.
Please update your address.
I'll give you an update tomorrow.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo más moderno; información nueva.

definition: The area behind a house.
examples: The kids are playing in the backyard.
We have a pool in the backyard.
My dad grows tomatoes in the backyard.

spanish.definition: Área detrás de una casa.

definition: A person who does something for fun and not for money.
examples: He's an amateur photographer.
She played golf as an amateur.
This looks like the work of an amateur.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace algo por diversión y no por dinero.

definition: Red spots on the skin.
examples: The baby has a rash on her arm.
That plant gave me a rash.
This cream will help your rash.

spanish.definition: Manchas rojas en la piel.

definition: Honest and worthy of respect.
examples: He's an honorable man.
She did the honorable thing.
It's an honorable job.

spanish.definition: Honesto y digno de respeto.

definition: Bright and reflecting light.
examples: He bought a shiny new car.
Her hair is very shiny.
I found a shiny coin.

spanish.definition: Luminoso y que refleja la luz.

definition: A large bird that hunts small animals.
examples: A hawk flew over the field.
The hawk caught a mouse.
He watches me like a hawk.

spanish.definition: Ave grande que caza animales pequeños.

definition: A person who speaks or acts for other people.
examples: A sales representative called me.
She's our representative in Congress.
Please talk to a customer service representative.

spanish.definition: Persona que habla o actúa por otros.

definition: Great worry or pain.
examples: She was in great distress.
The ship sent a distress signal.
The news caused him a lot of distress.

spanish.definition: Gran preocupación o dolor.

definition: A prize, often made of metal, for winning a competition.
examples: Our team won the trophy.
He keeps his trophies on a shelf.
She held the trophy over her head.

spanish.definition: Premio, a menudo de metal, por ganar una competencia.

definition: To clean a toilet with water; to become red in the face.
examples: Don't forget to flush the toilet.
He flushed the paper down the toilet.
Her face flushed with anger.

spanish.definition: Limpiar un inodoro con agua; ponerse rojo de la cara.

definition: A person who does magic tricks.
examples: The magician pulled a rabbit out of a hat.
We hired a magician for the party.
He wants to be a magician.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace trucos de magia.

definition: To take control of a place by force; to defeat a problem.
examples: Spain conquered Mexico in 1521.
She conquered her fear of flying.
The army conquered the city.

spanish.definition: Tomar el control de un lugar por la fuerza; vencer un problema.

definition: Not nice.
examples: There's an unpleasant smell in here.
It was an unpleasant surprise.
He's an unpleasant person.

spanish.definition: Que no es agradable.

definition: The feeling of being unhappy because someone has what you want.
examples: His jealousy ended their marriage.
She felt a little jealousy.
Jealousy can hurt a friendship.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de infelicidad porque alguien tiene lo que quieres.

definition: Poisonous; very bad for you.
examples: These chemicals are toxic.
That plant is toxic to dogs.
She left a toxic relationship.

spanish.definition: Venenoso; muy malo para ti.

definition: A soft, sweet dessert.
examples: I love chocolate pudding.
We had rice pudding for dessert.
The kids ate all the pudding.

spanish.definition: Postre suave y dulce.

definition: A large public meeting to support something; a car race.
examples: Thousands of people went to the rally.
He spoke at a political rally.
She drives in a car rally.

spanish.definition: Gran reunión pública para apoyar algo; carrera de carros.

definition: To produce flowers; a flower.
examples: Roses bloom in the summer.
The trees are in full bloom.
These flowers bloom only at night.

spanish.definition: Producir flores; una flor.

definition: A large company.
examples: He works for a big corporation.
Some corporations don't pay much in taxes.
The corporation has offices in ten countries.

spanish.definition: Compañía grande.

definition: A medical problem; a lack of order.
examples: He has a sleep disorder.
Eating disorders are serious.
The house was in disorder.

spanish.definition: Problema médico; falta de orden.

definition: To stop.
examples: The fighting ceased at midnight.
You never cease to surprise me.
The company ceased to exist.

spanish.definition: Parar.

definition: Showing good judgment.
examples: She's a very sensible girl.
That's a sensible idea.
Wear sensible shoes for the hike.

spanish.definition: Que muestra buen juicio.

definition: An expert, especially a doctor who treats one kind of problem.
examples: I need to see a heart specialist.
She's a specialist in Asian art.
The doctor sent me to a specialist.

spanish.definition: Experto, sobre todo médico que trata un tipo de problema.

definition: Money given to someone to make them do something dishonest; to give this money.
examples: The officer took a bribe.
He tried to bribe the judge.
I bribed my son with candy.

spanish.definition: Dinero dado a alguien para que haga algo deshonesto; darlo.

definition: A paper from a doctor that lets you get medicine.
examples: The doctor gave me a prescription.
I need to fill this prescription.
You can't buy this without a prescription.

spanish.definition: Papel de un médico que te permite conseguir medicina.

definition: The event when you finish school or college.
examples: My parents came to my graduation.
He got a job after graduation.
Her graduation is in June.

spanish.definition: Evento en que terminas la escuela o universidad.

definition: A pattern of lines that cross and make squares; a system of power lines.
examples: The streets are built on a grid.
Draw a grid on the paper.
The storm knocked out the power grid.

spanish.definition: Patrón de líneas que forman cuadrados; sistema de cables eléctricos.

definition: The act of cutting someone's hair; the style of the hair after it.
examples: I need a haircut.
Do you like my new haircut?
He gets a haircut every month.

spanish.definition: Acción de cortar el pelo; estilo que queda.

definition: Without paying attention to a problem or a difference.
examples: We'll go, regardless of the weather.
Everyone pays the same, regardless of age.
He knew the danger but continued regardless.

spanish.word: a pesar de todo / sin importar
spanish.definition: Sin prestar atención a un problema o diferencia.

definition: A small house in the country or the mountains.
examples: We stayed in a ski lodge.
The hunters met at the lodge.
The lodge has a big fireplace.

spanish.definition: Casa pequeña en el campo o las montañas.

definition: One of the soft things that cover a bird's body.
examples: The bird lost a feather.
This pillow is full of feathers.
It's as light as a feather.

spanish.definition: Una de las cosas suaves que cubren el cuerpo de un ave.

definition: Programs that make a computer work.
examples: He writes software for banks.
You need to install this software.
The software is free.

spanish.definition: Programas que hacen funcionar una computadora.

definition: For a short time.
examples: Let's sit here awhile.
He stayed awhile and then left.
Please wait here awhile.

spanish.definition: Por un tiempo corto.

definition: A long soft seat for two or more people.
examples: We sat on the sofa and watched TV.
The cat sleeps on the sofa.
You can sleep on the sofa tonight.

spanish.definition: Asiento largo y suave para dos o más personas.

definition: Awake; knowing that something exists or is happening.
examples: He's still conscious after the fall.
She's very conscious of her weight.
It was a conscious decision.

spanish.definition: Despierto; que sabe que algo existe o pasa.

definition: Not by accident; on purpose.
examples: He deliberately broke the window.
She deliberately ignored me.
I didn't do it deliberately.

spanish.definition: No por accidente; con intención.

definition: A small green or black fruit that gives oil; a dull green color.
examples: Add some olives to the salad.
Cook it in olive oil.
He wore an olive jacket.

spanish.definition: Fruto pequeño verde o negro del que sale aceite; color verde apagado.

definition: Connected to the mind.
examples: He has psychological problems.
The stress had a psychological effect on her.
I love psychological movies.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la mente.

definition: A thin tube for drinking; dry stems of plants.
examples: Can I have a straw for my soda?
The horse sleeps on straw.
She bought a straw hat.

spanish.definition: Tubo delgado para beber; tallos secos de plantas.

definition: A list of things to talk about at a meeting.
examples: What's on the agenda today?
She sent the agenda for the meeting.
The first item on the agenda is the budget.

spanish.definition: Lista de cosas por tratar en una reunión.

definition: A sticky substance that joins things; to join things with it.
examples: I fixed the cup with glue.
Glue the two pieces of paper together.
The kids need glue for their project.

spanish.definition: Sustancia que une cosas; unirlas con ella.

definition: A man whose job is to sell things.
examples: He's a car salesman.
A salesman came to the door.
My uncle was a good salesman.

spanish.definition: Hombre cuyo trabajo es vender cosas.

definition: A small American restaurant with simple, cheap food.
examples: We had breakfast at a diner.
There's an old diner on the highway.
She works at the diner on Main Street.

spanish.definition: Restaurante estadounidense pequeño de comida simple y barata.

definition: Connected to living things; related by birth.
examples: She found her biological mother.
Scientists study biological changes.
He's my biological father.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con los seres vivos; pariente de nacimiento.

definition: Honest and truly meaning what you say.
examples: Please accept my sincere thanks.
He seems like a sincere person.
Her apology was sincere.

spanish.definition: Honesto y que de verdad siente lo que dice.

definition: Disagreeing with something.
examples: I'm opposed to the new law.
Many people are opposed to the plan.
His parents were opposed to the marriage.

spanish.definition: Que no está de acuerdo con algo.

definition: A person who secretly gets information; to watch someone secretly.
examples: He was a spy during the war.
They were spying on us.
I love spy movies.

spanish.definition: Persona que consigue información en secreto; vigilar a alguien así.

definition: A quick drawing; to draw quickly.
examples: She made a sketch of the house.
He sketched her face in five minutes.
The artist showed us some sketches.

spanish.definition: Dibujo rápido; dibujar rápido.

definition: A group of people who make laws in some countries.
examples: The British Parliament meets in London.
She's a member of parliament.
Parliament passed the new law.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas que hacen las leyes en algunos países.

definition: The subject that people talk or write about.
examples: Let's change the topic.
What's the topic of your essay?
Money is a difficult topic.

spanish.definition: Asunto del que la gente habla o escribe.

definition: A curved shape like a circle.
examples: Make a loop with the rope.
The road makes a loop around the lake.
This song plays on a loop.

spanish.definition: Forma curva como un círculo.

definition: Having light yellow hair.
examples: She has long blond hair.
Her son is tall and blond.
All the kids in her family are blond.

spanish.definition: Que tiene el pelo amarillo claro.

definition: A large pink fish you can eat.
examples: We had grilled salmon for dinner.
Salmon swim up the river.
I love salmon with rice.

spanish.definition: Pez grande y rosado que se puede comer.

definition: Very strange.
examples: That's a bizarre story.
He has a bizarre sense of humor.
It was a bizarre accident.

spanish.definition: Muy raro.

definition: Secret; not for other people to see.
examples: This information is confidential.
Your medical records are confidential.
She gave me a confidential report.

spanish.definition: Secreto; no es para que otros lo vean.

definition: The act of following or trying to get something.
examples: The police are in pursuit of the car.
The pursuit of happiness is a basic right.
He moved to the city in pursuit of a better job.

spanish.definition: Acción de seguir o tratar de conseguir algo.

definition: Something new that someone creates for the first time.
examples: The telephone was a great invention.
What's the best invention in history?
This machine is his own invention.

spanish.definition: Algo nuevo que alguien crea por primera vez.

definition: A person or a thing that takes the place of another.
examples: We need a replacement for the broken part.
They found a replacement for the old teacher.
He had a knee replacement last year.

spanish.definition: Persona o cosa que toma el lugar de otra.

definition: The quality of being honest.
examples: He's a man of integrity.
I respect her integrity.
She has too much integrity to lie.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser honesto.

definition: To run somewhere quickly; a quick run; a short line in writing.
examples: She dashed out of the house.
I made a dash for the bus.
Use a dash between the two numbers.

spanish.definition: Correr rápido a un lugar; carrera rápida; línea corta al escribir.

definition: One of the two parts of the US Congress.
examples: The Senate passed the bill.
She ran for the Senate in Ohio.
He spent ten years in the Senate.

spanish.definition: Una de las dos partes del Congreso de Estados Unidos.

definition: A member of a group of violent criminals.
examples: He played a gangster in the movie.
Al Capone was a famous gangster.
The gangster went to prison.

spanish.definition: Miembro de un grupo de criminales violentos.

definition: Something you plan to do; not influenced by personal feelings.
examples: Our main objective is to win.
Try to be objective.
What are your objectives for this year?

spanish.definition: Algo que planeas hacer; no influido por sentimientos personales.

definition: Completely; in total.
examples: He stopped smoking altogether.
Altogether, there are thirty of us.
That's altogether different.

spanish.definition: Completamente; en total.

definition: To make people or things come to you; to make someone interested.
examples: The beach attracts many tourists.
Flowers attract bees.
What attracted you to him?

spanish.definition: Hacer que personas o cosas vengan a ti; despertar interés.

definition: A flat case for carrying papers.
examples: He carries a leather briefcase to work.
She opened her briefcase and took out a folder.
I left my briefcase on the train.

spanish.definition: Maleta plana para llevar papeles.

definition: A toy person or animal that you move with your hand or strings.
examples: The kids watched a puppet show.
She made a puppet from an old sock.
The government is a puppet of the army.

spanish.definition: Muñeco que se mueve con la mano o con hilos.

definition: To make something the way it was before.
examples: They restored the old house.
He restores old cars.
The power was restored after two hours.

spanish.definition: Dejar algo como estaba antes.

definition: A flat round cake cooked in a pan.
examples: We had pancakes for breakfast.
I put syrup on my pancakes.
Dad makes the best pancakes.

spanish.definition: Pastel plano y redondo cocinado en sartén.

definition: A long passage in a building with doors on the sides.
examples: Her office is at the end of the corridor.
We walked down a long corridor.
The hospital corridor was empty.

spanish.definition: Paso largo en un edificio con puertas a los lados.

definition: To make someone feel ashamed or uncomfortable.
examples: Please don't embarrass me in front of my friends.
My mother embarrassed me at the party.
It embarrasses him to talk about it.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien sienta vergüenza o incomodidad.

definition: A large collection of information in a computer.
examples: Your name is in our database.
The police checked their database.
He designs databases for hospitals.

spanish.definition: Gran colección de información en una computadora.

definition: To give someone hope or confidence to do something.
examples: My parents encouraged me to study music.
She always encourages her students.
We encourage people to recycle.

spanish.definition: Dar a alguien esperanza o confianza para hacer algo.

definition: Connected to what is being discussed.
examples: That's not relevant to our discussion.
Please include all relevant information.
Is this still relevant today?

spanish.definition: Relacionado con lo que se está discutiendo.

definition: The money that you spend on something.
examples: Rent is my biggest expense.
We had a lot of travel expenses.
The company pays all my expenses.

spanish.definition: Dinero que gastas en algo.

definition: Not broken or damaged.
examples: The vase arrived intact.
The old bridge is still intact.
Her house stayed intact after the storm.

spanish.definition: Sin romper ni dañar.

definition: Sometimes, but not often.
examples: I occasionally eat meat.
We see each other occasionally.
He occasionally calls his mother.

spanish.definition: A veces, pero no seguido.

definition: The movement or sound of your heart.
examples: The doctor listened to the baby's heartbeat.
I could feel my heartbeat in my ears.
His heartbeat is normal.

spanish.definition: Movimiento o sonido de tu corazón.

definition: Exactly the same.
examples: They are identical twins.
The two bags look identical.
Your phone is identical to mine.

spanish.definition: Exactamente igual.

definition: A thick roll of tobacco leaves for smoking.
examples: My grandfather smoked a cigar after dinner.
He brought some cigars from Cuba.
The room smelled of cigars.

spanish.definition: Rollo grueso de hojas de tabaco para fumar.

definition: Traditional; serious music like Mozart's.
examples: She listens to classical music.
He studies classical Greek.
The building has a classical style.

spanish.definition: Tradicional; música seria como la de Mozart.

definition: Always behaving or happening in the same way.
examples: You have to be consistent with your kids.
His work is consistent and good.
She's our most consistent player.

spanish.definition: Que siempre se comporta o pasa de la misma manera.

definition: A small object that holds things; a short video; to cut small parts off.
examples: She held her hair with a clip.
I saw a funny clip online.
He clipped the dog's nails.

spanish.definition: Objeto pequeño que sujeta cosas; video corto; cortar partes pequeñas.

definition: To leave your job by your own decision.
examples: She resigned from her job last week.
The minister resigned after the scandal.
I'm going to resign tomorrow.

spanish.definition: Dejar tu trabajo por tu propia decisión.

definition: Grown without chemicals.
examples: I buy organic vegetables.
They run an organic farm.
Organic food costs more.

spanish.definition: Cultivado sin químicos.

definition: To take something quickly or with force.
examples: He seized my arm.
The police seized the drugs.
You should seize this opportunity.

spanish.definition: Tomar algo rápido o con fuerza.

definition: A large black bird.
examples: A crow sat on the fence.
Crows are very smart birds.
We heard a crow in the morning.

spanish.definition: Ave grande y negra.

definition: A structure that throws water into the air.
examples: There's a fountain in the park.
She threw a coin in the fountain.
Kids were playing near the fountain.

spanish.definition: Estructura que lanza agua al aire.

definition: The act of watching something carefully; a comment.
examples: He's in the hospital for observation.
That's an interesting observation.
We learned a lot through observation.

spanish.definition: Acción de mirar algo con cuidado; comentario.

definition: A track for trains; the system of trains.
examples: He worked on the railroad for thirty years.
We live near the railroad.
The railroad crosses the river here.

spanish.definition: Vía para trenes; sistema de trenes.

definition: To make something straight or neat.
examples: She straightened her hair.
Let me straighten your tie.
He straightened up and looked at me.

spanish.definition: Poner algo recto u ordenado.

definition: Allowed by the law; fair and reasonable.
examples: It's a legitimate business.
That's a legitimate question.
He has a legitimate reason to be angry.

spanish.definition: Permitido por la ley; justo y razonable.

definition: A tool with points that you use to eat food.
examples: Put the fork on the left of the plate.
Can I have a clean fork?
He ate the salad with a fork.

spanish.definition: Utensilio con puntas que se usa para comer.

definition: Using computer technology.
examples: I bought a digital camera.
We live in a digital world.
This clock has a digital display.

spanish.definition: Que usa tecnología de computadoras.

definition: A room at the top of a house under the roof.
examples: The old photos are in the attic.
We keep the Christmas decorations in the attic.
There's something moving in the attic.

spanish.definition: Cuarto en lo alto de una casa, bajo el techo.
